title: I Recorded the Overnight Generator the Landlord Called a Fan

parts.text: I recorded the alley at 1:19 a.m. because the landlord's new generator for the illegal basement unit shook my headboard. He had told the inspector it was a ventilation fan. I was thirty-two, 1B, holding a decibel app that read 71. The lease promised quiet enjoyment, a phrase that looks silly until 1:19. I emailed the clip, the 71, and his fan email to housing. At 1:27 he texted that I was going to get a family evicted in winter.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: He is blaming me for a winter eviction while the generator is still a fan on paper.

social.video_title: 71 decibels, a fan on the inspection form — Part 1/2
social.description: Headboard, basement unit, quiet enjoyment. The text came. Would you have stopped the email?

parts.text: Housing heard a generator. The unit got a real permit path or a shutdown; they chose shutdown until permits. The family moved upstairs with help the city listed, not with my scalp. The alley quieted. Quiet enjoyment returned to looking silly in a good way. Fans do not have pull cords that smell like gasoline. I sleep. 1B is a bedroom again. Headboards should not be instruments.

social.video_title: Shutdown until permits, alley quiet — Part 2/2
social.description: Housing, upstairs help, gasoline not a fan. Was 71 a breeze?
